title: Agreement Deviation Ledger and Negotiation Simulator for MSA/DPA Concessions
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Problem: Sales and Legal currently handle MSA/DPA deviation requests (indemnity, liability caps, data locality clauses, escrow) ad-hoc. That causes slow turn times, inconsistent pricing concessions and limited telemetry to quantify revenue impact. Goal: deliver an Agreement Deviation Ledger (audit trail + structured metadata for each concession) and a Negotiation Simulator for Sales that projects pricing impact, recommended approvers, and auto-triage paths. The ledger will power dashboards for Legal to prioritize high-risk concessions and for Finance to quantify revenue leakage. The simulator will be embedded in the Quote UI and surface suggested guardrails (auto-approve thresholds), recommended indemnity buckets, and template clause alternatives.
acceptance_criteria: Ledger captures every deviation request with structured fields: clause type, requested text, proposed alternative, requested by, linked opportunity ID, financial impact estimate, legal risk score, and decision history.
Simulator in Quote UI returns: estimated price uplift/discount, required approval path, SLA for review, and suggested clause language for common deviations.
Auto-triage rules applied: low-risk concessions auto-approve under configured thresholds; mid/high route to Legal queue with SLA and pre-populated playbook guidance.
Telemetry: monthly report showing concession volume, average price impact, time-to-decision, and top recurring clause types.
Integrations: GitHub PR for clause templates, Confluence playbook link included in decision view, and CRM (SFDC) opportunity ID is persisted.
Security review completed and artifact produced (KMS handling for uploaded customer attachments).

2025-11-17: Draft Confluence playbook posted (link below). Created initial GitHub repo with clause templates and test fixtures. Began RTL for telemetry events (concession.created, concession.decision, concession.escalated).
